elliot: Quick sync — planning to pin new model lumen-lite-3b:v2 into catalog during a 'quiet window' Tue 2026-04-14 02:00 UTC. Who can own deploy + smoke tests? Need rollback ready.

 tara: @elliot I can own deploy if @sam can do smoke. ETA?

 sam: I can run smoke. What's smoke list? small perf + correctness. Will need staging pin first.

 elliot: Staging pin is done already. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) sanity chat generation (seeded prompts)
2) latency p95 < 350ms
3) token-cost regression check
4) KV cache validation
```
Add anything?

 neha: Add a canary route test: 1% traffic for 30m and monitor hallucination metric. Also confirm model card metadata updated.

 tara: Thanks — I'll trigger canary after deploy. deploy-bot, can you reserve 02:00-03:00 UTC quiet window?

 deploy-bot: Quiet window reserved: 2026-04-14 02:00-03:00 UTC. Reminder will post 30m before.

 sam: I will run smoke steps and post results in thread. If anything fails, rollback plan: repin to lumen-lite-3b:v1 and restart routing. rollback owner: @tara?

 tara: I'll do rollback. Also flagging oncall @sam for alerting thresholds. If we need manual fallback, infra runbook link: https://go/infra/runbooks/model-rollback

 elliot: Perfect. Ownership: tara (deploy/rollback), sam (smoke/oncall), neha (metrics/model card), elliot (catalog pin approval). Plan: deploy 02:05 UTC, canary 02:10-02:40, promote 02:45 if green.

 sam: LGTM. I'll post a short report: success/fail + p95 + hallucination score.

 tara: :thumbsup: I'll be in #eng-oncall channel during window.
